historical_reviews.deepseek: Its command, duration, evidence and risk describe the other duplicate-code SDR-stress variant and cannot guide this time-setting row.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly re-anchors the review to the direct row and treats time synchronization, clock write and chronology restoration as one controlled transaction.
historical_reviews.history: Sequence 1784 reviewed the distinct row-1646 Stress/BMC SDR variant; it is not reusable for this row.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Disabling NTP, writing SEL time and re-enabling NTP creates at least two clock transitions. Exact immediate readback can still be overwritten by synchronization, and restoring the clock cannot repair event timestamps written during the changed interval.

original_test_intent: Set one approved BMC SEL clock value through the documented IPMI path while controlling NTP, verify exact display and subsequent synchronization behavior, and restore the original time-source state with preserved chronology.
original_method: Capture same-target IB/OOB identity, original SEL time/offset/NTP/server/status and representative event timestamps; validate documented disable/set/enable commands and approved time basis; perform one write through the selected path; verify exact readback; re-enable and observe bounded convergence; restore the required final baseline and label the altered chronology interval.
manual_activity: The owner approves the exact timestamp, time basis, selected path and required final NTP state; the vendor/package owner validates raw commands; the operator reviews chronology and restoration before the verdict.
required_inputs: Original SEL time, offset, NTP flag/server/status
safety_requirements: Never use the 1990 example without explicit approval
Write one approved timestamp through one selected path
Stop on overwrite, wrong target or ambiguous time basis
Never retry an ambiguous time write automatically
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and full time baseline
Capture exact readback and convergence timeline
Restore and verify final time-source state
Archive evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve timestamp, offset and final state
Approve vendor raw commands and selected path

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The DeepSeek SDR polling loop belongs to the other duplicate-code variant and does not test any date/time criterion in this row.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the vendor-documented protected NTP disable, one approved `sel time set`, exact get/readback, NTP enable and bounded convergence sequence through a verified same target, followed by complete restoration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The 10/10-minute disable-set-get-enable-get sequence is preserved; the 1990 example is treated as non-executable illustration and duplicate-row SDR stress is excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Maintain an immutable timeline of original time/sync state, approved converted set value, every command/response, immediate readback, NTP re-enable, convergence/reference delta, affected SEL events and final restored state.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit source-variant isolation, time-basis validation, convergence observation and chronology-aware restoration.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A successful set and matching immediate display do not prove NTP was restored, the time basis was correct or later events remain interpretable.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Clock restoration cannot undo timestamps already emitted during the test; those records must remain labeled with the applied offset interval.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define whether IB and OOB are alternative evidence paths or separate set executions; default to one state-changing write. It must also specify raw command semantics and final NTP policy. The row-1646 stress variant remains independent despite the duplicated code.
expected_evidence: Approval, target/variant identity and original time/NTP/offset/server baseline
Vendor raw command contract and approved timestamp conversion
Immediate readback plus bounded NTP convergence/reference delta
Representative SEL chronology across the altered interval
Restored final time-source state, no-clear/no-retry audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target BMC time setting with NTP control. DeepSeek's unrelated SDR stress content is a reference-row mismatch, while the distinct duplicate-code variant is preserved by source identity.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor raw semantics, timestamp policy and restoration are obtainable project inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED if they cannot be established or time-source restoration cannot be assured.

review_improvement: Corrects a duplicate-code reference mismatch and turns a chronology-altering example into one approved, source-specific, fully restored time transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: Immediate SEL-time readback can be correct even if the BMC later applies NTP with a different timezone or offset. Conversely, a sync step may intentionally overwrite the manual value, so the oracle must distinguish set correctness from convergence correctness. The duplicate code demonstrates why code-only joins are unsafe: row/hash/variant identity is required before reusing any review evidence.
